description.zh:
能力。默认understand，取值：
- understand 理解
- understand-reid 含reid理解
- search 搜索
description.en:
Capability. Default value is understand. Valid values:

- understand: understanding

- understand-reid: understanding with reid

- search: search

description.zh: 结束时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。与StartTime相差不超过180天。
description.en: End Time. UTC time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The difference between EndTime and StartTime must not exceed 180 days.
Page number for paging. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为50。
description.en: Page size, which specifies the number of entries displayed per page. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 50.
Start Time. UTC time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.
